Description: Pop open the Group and Activity Finder tab to check out the Group Finder. There you'll find all manner of social activities to collaborate, and crush, with your fellow players!
Team up for victory! Check out currently available listings by opening up the guild tab!
Player guilds pay for the services of loyal traders in major cities across Tamriel. Open the map and look for the scales-and-shield icon. Go see what's on offer!
Put your PvP skills to the test. Enter a Battleground match by opening up the Group and Activity Finder.
Activity Reward: File:ON-icon-container-PvP Reward Container.png Battlemaster Rivyn's Reward Box

Activity: Do or Heal 1000 Points of Damage in Cyrodiil
Description: Enter the fray! Jump into the PvP arena that is Cyrodiil via the Alliance War tab. Aid your chosen alliance for honor and glory!

Activity: Visit 3 Recommended Homes With Home Tours
Description: Curious about what your fellow players are up to at home? Seek out the Home Tours feature via the Group and Activity Finder. Visit someone in the Recommended Homes tab and enjoy that creativity!

Ready to take on a bigger challenge? Head over to the Group and Activity Finder and queue up for a Random Dungeon. Or group up with some friends and pick one to head out! Just remember, dungeons and delves aren't the same thing!
Gather your allies and complete Trials.

Activity: Buy from the Crown Store With Endeavor Seals
Description: You can earn seals by completing Daily and even Weekly Endeavors, viewable in the Group and Activity Finder. Use those seals to buy cosmetics, furnishings, mounts, and more in the Seals of Endeavor tab on the Crown Store.
Go out and be sneaky. If you find a locked chest or door you just know there's something good on the other side. Grab a lockpick and pop it open!
